pages.title: Guide Shelf
pages.text: **Guide Shelf** puts buttons in your inventory screen for every in-game guide book, this Field Guide included.

pages.title: Guide Shelf
pages.text: Open a guide without holding the book. Handy for mods that ship their own handbook.

You also get this book on first join, and can craft it from a Book and Andesite (shapeless). JEI can open it too.

Mods like Create keep help in Ponder: hold **W** over an item.
